commentary.text: 90+10' The match has just finished.
90+8' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 19:14.
90+7' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
90+6' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
90+5' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Emiliano Martinez easily deals with the threat.
90+4' The Aston Villa players can’t believe it after referee Simon Hooper signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
90+3' There's a break in play and referee Simon Hooper must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Aston Villa using VAR. This could be interesting!
90+3' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
90+3' The referee awards a corner and Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) goes over to take it.
90+2' A tremendous drive by Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Alisson makes a brilliant save.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.

88' 3 - 3 Goal! Great play by Moussa Diaby releases Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into the right side of the goal. 3:3.
87' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
86' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) hits a shot towards the right side of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Emiliano Martinez.
85' Referee Simon Hooper halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Unai Emery, then shows him a yellow.
85' 2 - 3 Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) doesn't hesitate to lash home from just outside the box. He hits the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and it nestles in the net.
84' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
83' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

82' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the roof of the net, but Emiliano Martinez thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
80' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
80' Here is a change. Douglas Luiz is going off and Unai Emery gives the last tactical orders to Calum Chambers (Aston Villa).
79' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Jhon Duran replaces him.
78' The game is interrupted now, Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
77' Emiliano Martinez pulls off a great save to deny Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal.
76' Jurgen Klopp has decided to substitute Wataru Endo and he is replaced by Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool).
76' Jurgen Klopp decides to make a substitution. Luis Diaz will be replaced by Curtis Jones (Liverpool).
75' Jurgen Klopp prepares a substitution. Harvey Elliott is replaced by Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool).
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) comes onto the pitch so that Cody Gakpo can be given a rest.
75' The corner kick from Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
74' A cross from Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
73' The photographers scatter as a shot from the edge of the box by Joe Gomez (Liverpool) blazes well wide of the right post.
71' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but Emiliano Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.
69' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Alisson.
69' John McGinn (Aston Villa) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
68' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
68' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) commits a rough challenge and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul.
67' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
65' It will be a substitution. Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) is ready to enter the pitch as Youri Tielemans walks off.
63' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
61' The resulting corner from Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
60' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Liverpool due to an offside in the build-up play.
60' Attention! Referee Simon Hooper straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
59' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) has a goal ruled out for offside!
55' Simon Hooper has a clear sight and sees a foul from Wataru Endo (Liverpool).
55' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
54' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post.
54' The goal by Aston Villa is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
53' Wait! Referee Simon Hooper has indicated he is going to review the Aston Villa goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
52' Goal - 2:3! Leon Bailey tees up Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) inside the box and he curls the ball into the left side of the net and past Alisson.
51' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Leon Bailey, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
48' 1 - 3 Harvey Elliott executes the free kick and sends it inside the box where it's met by Jarell Quansah (Liverpool). He plants a header in off the inside of the left post. The score is 1:3.
47' John McGinn (Aston Villa) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alisson intercepts the ball.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
45+4' John McGinn (Aston Villa) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45+3' John McGinn (Aston Villa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45+2' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:2.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is flagged for offside.
45' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
43' That's a well-taken pass by Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
42' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
41' The foul by Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) was seen by Simon Hooper who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
41' Aston Villa work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
39' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
38' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
38' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
37' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
36' Leon Bailey rounds off a good move with a layoff to Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) inside the box, he has a clear sight of goal but sends the ball just wide of the left post.
34' A clumsy foul by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) and Simon Hooper blows his whistle.

34' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Simon Hooper with no other option than to blow for a foul.
33' John McGinn (Aston Villa) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
31' An attempted cross from Joe Gomez (Liverpool) is cleared.
30' Aston Villa players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
28' Simon Hooper blows his whistle as Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
26' Simon Hooper sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
24' The Liverpool players halt their celebrations as referee Simon Hooper makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
23' 1 - 2 Goal! The rebound fell to Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) and he fired home from close range. The score is 1:2.
23' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
21' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) heads on.
21' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
20' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
19' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) makes a rough challenge and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
17' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
15' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
12' 1 - 1 Goal! Ollie Watkins slips it to Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) on the edge of the box and he finds the bottom left corner with a great effort. The score is 1:1.
11' Flag up against Luis Diaz (Liverpool). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
9' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
7' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
5' An accurate cross picks out Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
5' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
4' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
